Privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy — Guest & Host Data Protection
Privacy.metaDesc: Learn how StayVilla safely handles your data when connecting directly with private villa hosts in Bali via WhatsApp.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At StayVilla, we deeply respect and protect your privacy. This policy outlines how information is handled when you browse curated luxury villas and initiate direct reservation inquiries.
Privacy.sec1Desc: We collect only essential details needed to facilitate seamless direct inquiries between travelers and villa owners.
Privacy.sec1Point1: Search input data (destination keyword, check-in & check-out dates, guest count).
Privacy.sec1Point2: Villa owner registration submissions (name, WhatsApp number, property location, bedroom count).
Privacy.sec1Point3: Language and currency preferences stored locally on your device (localStorage).
Privacy.sec2Desc: Reservation parameters are used exclusively to format direct WhatsApp inquiry links addressed to the villa manager.
Privacy.sec2Point1: Pre-filling reservation details for your conversational booking convenience.
Privacy.sec2Point2: Rendering live foreign currency estimates for travel budgeting purposes.
Privacy.sec2Point3: We never sell, rent, or distribute your personal details to third-party ad networks.
Privacy.sec3Desc: Direct communications and booking confirmations occur over WhatsApp's end-to-end encrypted infrastructure.
Privacy.sec3Point1: All villa owner phone numbers are verified prior to listing publication.
Privacy.sec3Point2: Payments and deposits are arranged directly with the host's bank account with zero middleman holding.
Privacy.sec3Point3: StayVilla does not collect or store sensitive credit card or banking credentials.
Privacy.sec4Desc: We use browser local storage strictly to remember your language and currency preferences.
Privacy.sec4Point1: No invasive third-party tracking or behavioral profiling cookies.
Privacy.sec4Point2: You can clear your local preferences at any time via standard browser settings.
Privacy.sec5Desc: You maintain full rights to request updates or delisting of your property information at any time.
Privacy.sec5Point1: Villa owners may request profile updates or removal whenever needed.
Privacy.sec5Point2: Privacy-related inquiries can be directed straight to our compliance team.
Privacy.contactDesc: Have questions about our data protection practices? Reach out to our privacy officer:

Help.title: StayVilla Help Center
Help.subtitle: Find quick answers about villa reservations, direct payment workflows, and our concierge services in Bali
Help.qBookingFlow: How do I book a villa on StayVilla?
Help.aBookingFlow: Select your preferred villa, choose your check-in & check-out dates and guest count, then click 'Book via WhatsApp'. Our system automatically generates a formatted reservation summary and opens a direct WhatsApp chat with the villa host. Availability confirmation, special requests, and payment are settled directly between you and the host (not processed on this website).
Help.qPaymentOnSite: Is payment processed on this website?
Help.aPaymentOnSite: No. StayVilla operates as a curated directory connector and does not process payments or collect guest fees on the site. All financial transactions (deposit and final settlement) are transferred directly to the villa owner's verified bank account as agreed in WhatsApp.
Help.qNoReply: What should I do if the villa host doesn't reply?
Help.aNoReply: Hosts typically respond within a few hours during business hours. If you haven't received a reply within 24 hours, you can explore alternative villas in our collection or reach out to StayVilla Admin via WhatsApp for assistance.
Help.aCancellation: Cancellation, refund, and rescheduling policies are set individually by each villa owner. We recommend confirming the cancellation terms in writing directly on WhatsApp before completing any deposit transfer.
Help.aPriceFinal: Listed prices are indicative base nightly rates. The final rate may adjust based on seasonality (peak/high season), length of stay, or custom host promotions agreed upon during WhatsApp confirmation.
Help.qCurrency: What currency is used for payment?
Help.aCurrency: All official invoicing and final payments are settled in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). Foreign currency displays on our site are indicative estimates based on prevailing exchange rates for your convenience.
Help.qListVilla: How can I list my villa on StayVilla?
Help.aListVilla: Villa owners or managers in Bali can register their properties by visiting our 'List Your Villa' page (/untuk-pemilik) and completing the short registration form. Our team will verify and prepare your curated listing free of charge.
Help.stillNeedHelpDesc: StayVilla support team is ready to assist you with inquiries and reservation guidance.
